$comment: Sinopia design tokens (place-based drawing app). Source of truth for every visual value; DESIGN_BRIEF.md gives the reasons.

Status: LOCKED to the ink-and-yellow direction (D-014, revised 2026-09-28). The interface is the sketch and the real world is the wall: app chrome is drawn in ink on paper with one yellow pencil for emphasis; photos and frescoes stay untouched.

Slot names are kept from the AEGIS draft so existing stylesheets keep working; the values and roles are the design kit's. The 'alias' group emits the kit's own variable names (--paper, --ink, --yellow ...) so component CSS can read either way.
No dark mode: it is paper. Artists judge their drawing colors against a light frame.

bg.$description: kit(desk): the ground behind paper, and the letterbox around the photo in the Studio. A cool neutral chosen so it is not cream, which reads as the 2026 tasteful default.

surface.$description: kit(paper): sheets, forms, cards, lined areas. Plain notebook white.

surface-raised.$description: kit(paper): same white. There is one paper in this system; elevation is carried by the 2px ink outline and the hard offset, never by a lighter fill.

surface-hover.$description: kit(desk): hovered icon buttons and rows. Paper going one step toward the desk under it.

text-primary.$description: kit(ink): text, 2px outlines, icons. Ballpoint black, softened from pure #000.

text-secondary.$description: kit(ink-2): secondary text. 7.05:1 on paper, 6.12:1 on desk.

text-on-accent.$description: kit(ink): yellow is only ever a fill with INK on it (11.96:1). Never white text on yellow.

border.$description: kit(ink): there is one kind of edge, a 2px ink outline. Use with --edge-outline rather than a 1px hairline.

accent.$description: kit(yellow), sampled from Quick, Draw!'s sprite.svg. The signature fill: one yellow button per screen, plus the active tool, the selected chip, the reveal-slider thumb and globe clusters. Never text, never a thin line on white (1.46:1 fails).

accent-hover.$description: kit(yellow-edge), Quick, Draw! sprite.svg: the bottom lip of a yellow button's hard offset, and its pressed state.

accent-2.$description: kit(yellow-tint), Quick, Draw! sprite.svg: selected rows, active chips, notice fills. A surface, never text.

accent-3.$description: kit(rule): notebook lines. DECORATIVE ONLY at 1.41:1 - never a boundary, never text, never an icon that carries meaning.

sea.$description: kit(sea): globe and map water. A pale tint of the notebook rule so the map reads as drawn on the same paper.

success.$description: kit(ok), Quick, Draw! sprite green: success text or icon. 5.65:1 on paper.

warning.$description: kit: there is no warning text colour. A warning is INK text with a warning icon on a --color-accent-2 fill (the .notice component). No colored left stripe, ever.

danger.$description: kit(error): error text, icon and the danger button's border and offset. Red ballpoint, 6.54:1 on paper.

focus-ring.$description: kit(ink): focus outline. 13.4:1 on paper; sits on top of the 2px ink edge as an offset ring.

display.$description: kit(marker): the loud marker scrawl. Screen titles, fresco titles, primary buttons, empty-state headlines. SIL OFL on Google Fonts.

label.$description: kit(pencil) 700: the soft pencil that reads like a margin note. Tool names, chips, nav labels, field labels, small notes. SIL OFL.

body.$description: kit(print): every long text - captions, what-I-remember, license and creator lines, inputs, errors, dates, coordinates (with tabular-nums). Karla is Quick, Draw!'s own body face. SIL OFL. Handwriting is banned here.

caption.$description: kit(small): license lines, dates, attribution, helper text. Karla.

body.$description: kit(body): captions, memories, form inputs. 16px also stops iOS zooming inputs on focus.

label.$description: kit(label): tool names, chips, nav, field labels. Gaegu runs small, so 19 reads like 16.

button.$description: kit(button): primary and secondary button text. Gochi Hand.

h3.$description: kit(h2): section titles (Same Wall, Sinopias) and sheet titles. Gochi Hand.

h2.$description: kit(h1): screen titles and the fresco title in the viewer. Gochi Hand. 32px on laptop.

h1.$description: kit(display): empty-state headlines and the globe search placeholder. Gochi Hand. 44px on laptop.

display.$description: kit(display): the largest step. 44px on laptop. Handwriting never goes below 17px at the other end.

size-lg.$comment: kit: the only type values that change on laptop (>= breakpoint.lg). Everything else holds at the phone size.

h2.$description: kit: screen titles step up from 28

line-lg.$comment: kit: line heights paired with size-lg.

lined.$description: kit(paper): the notebook pitch. The 'what I remember' field uses it so typing sits ON the lines. Vertical rhythm inside lined areas snaps to 28 (7 x 4).

1.$description: kit: base unit. The scale is 4 8 12 16 24 32 48 64 and nothing else.

control.$description: kit: buttons, chips and inputs. Deliberately uneven so the shape reads as hand-cut rather than a library default. Plain CSS, no rough.js.

card.$description: kit: cards and popovers, one step larger and equally uneven.

sheet.$description: kit: bottom sheets. Top corners only; the sheet meets the bottom of the screen square.

photo.$description: kit: photos, frescoes and thumbnails. A printed photo, not a blob. There is no uniform 24px+ rounding anywhere.

outline.$description: kit: the one kind of edge. No blurred shadows and no backdrop-filter anywhere (it costs FPS on the mid-range Android NFR-002 targets).

offset.$description: kit: the hard offset under PRESSABLE things only. It is a solid box-shadow with no blur, so it is a drawn edge rather than a light source.

offset-yellow.$description: kit: the offset under a yellow button - its own darker lip, then the ink outline around it.

press.$description: kit: pressing moves the element down 3px into its offset. The chunky-button idea from Quick, Draw!, in our own shapes.

fast.$description: kit: the 3px press drop, the most repeated action in the app

draw.$description: kit: the signature moment - after Publish a hand-drawn ink circle scribbles around the new pin (SVG stroke). Skipped under prefers-reduced-motion.

fly.$description: kit: globe fly-to on a pin or cluster tap, so you keep your place on the planet

easing.$description: kit: standard deceleration. The reveal slider is deliberately UNEASED - it is driven straight off the input value.

md.$description: kit: reference panel docks to the right; viewer goes side-by-side

lg.$description: kit: laptop type step-up (display 44, h1 32); tool tray becomes a left rail; nav becomes a left rail

lines.$description: kit: the notebook paper background. 1px rule every 28px on paper. Use on the Capture, Finish and Sketchbook pages, sheets and popovers - NEVER behind a photo, the canvas, the globe or the viewer art.

nav-h.$description: kit: height of the bottom nav bar, so screens can reserve space for it
